slate_notes: Friday Nov 20: NBA only (9 games). There's no NFL game today (next is Sunday) and no NHL games on the board. I priced rebounds and assists for all 9 NBA games with pl price (18 credits; per-book devig median, 2+ books, unders shaded -3 pts), then checked each candidate against ESPN L10 game logs and the injury report. 9 legs in 8 games: 8 overs and 1 under. Only ORL@BKN has two legs, on different theses. PHX@UTA was skipped (no clean spot). Skipped: Braun U2.5 ast and J. Smith U2.5 ast (L10 contradicts the price), Battle U1.5 ast and Eason U1.5 ast (role expansion or L10 contradicts), Bey and B. Miller unders (teammates out, so role expanding), Mitchell/McCain/Gordon (game concentration). No cooldown conflicts (recent misses: Collins rec, Dunn reb, Jaquez reb, Seider SOG, Sengun ast). Confirm each line in the app and skip Goblin/Demon lines.

legs.reasoning: OKC is down Jalen Williams, Holmgren, Wallace and Sorber, so Mara has been a steady 18-32 min big who works as a hub out of the post/short roll. 7 of his last 10 cleared 1.5 ast (8, 3, 0, 2, 2, 3, 0, 2, 0, 3). The 4-book median devig of 61.5% at the exact 1.5 line is the estimate. Risk: OKC -11.5 vs a depleted NO side, so a blowout could trim his 4th-quarter minutes, but 2 ast is a low bar. This is the only OKC leg (Mitchell and McCain were also priced over, but I skipped them to avoid stacking one game).
